title: Repair learner Cardgen generation and nonblocking announcements

spec.problem: Cardgen UI buttons are covered by a queue of global announcement modals, Preview returns a placeholder contract that the UI cannot render, and Generate stores a nonexistent request table instead of creating study cards.

acceptance.text: Authenticated Cardgen preview returns estimatedCards and sampleCards from active canonical rows, obeys count/source/level/direction, and performs no persistence.
Authenticated Cardgen generation creates a private deck, generated cards, SRS user cards, and a completed generation job atomically; response includes deck, job, and cardsGenerated.
Anonymous Cardgen routes retain the existing learner session and CSRF enforcement; malformed requests return 400.
Announcement modals do not cover actions on core learner screens such as Cardgen; dismissing an announcement never auto-queues repeated modal interruptions.
Visible 390x844 Cardgen Preview and Generate complete successfully and the generated deck remains available after navigation/refresh; canonical vocab/kanji/grammar data is unchanged.

spec.expected_behavior: Announcements do not block core learning routes. Preview returns real samples selected from active canonical content without writing. Generate creates a private learner deck and user flashcards from active canonical content, records a completed generation job, and returns the shape consumed by the UI; canonical lexeme/kanji/grammar rows stay unchanged.
spec.observed_behavior: On the visible 390x844 Cardgen screen, repeated identical promotional dialogs intercept the preview button. Source inspection shows preview returns {preview,cards}, while the UI reads estimatedCards/sampleCards. Generate inserts into content.cardgen_request, for which there is no migration or schema model, and returns requestId while the UI expects job/deck/cardsGenerated.

classification.rationale: Also removes a stale SQL conformance baseline entry for the corrected Cardgen handler.

red_targets.test: AnnouncementStrip learner modal placement > does not cover Cardgen actions with a modal announcement
LearnerAnalyticsClient API contract > loads each selected period and refreshes through the UI handler
red_targets.expect: Chưa có đủ dữ liệu 30 ngày
